map.由生成 token 与时延估算推理吞吐。: Estimate inference throughput from generated tokens and latency.
map.推理服务的核心指标：总吞吐衡量集群利用率，单请求吞吐才是用户感知的快慢。batc: A core metric for inference serving: total throughput measures cluster utilization, while per-request throughput is what users feel as speed. Batching greatly raises total throughput but lengthens per-request latency, so online services usually trade off between them by SLO.
map.实际受批大小与排队影响。: Affected in practice by batch size and queuing.
map.吞吐≈生成 token 数 / 端到端时延(tokens/s)，衡量服务处理速度: Throughput ~ generated tokens / end-to-end latency (tokens/s), measuring serving speed.
map.受模型大小、批大小、KV 缓存与硬件带宽共同影响，非仅由 FLOPs 决定。: Driven jointly by model size, batch size, KV cache and hardware bandwidth, not solely by FLOPs.
map.容量规划用 吞吐×并发上限 估算峰值 QPS，需预留余量防雪崩。: For capacity planning, peak QPS ~ throughput x max concurrency, with headroom reserved against overload.
map.为什么吞吐不随并发线性增长？: Why does throughput not grow linearly with concurrency?
map.显存带宽与算力是共享瓶颈，多请求竞争 KV 缓存与计算单元，边际吞吐递减；需实测: Memory bandwidth and compute are shared bottlenecks; many requests compete for KV cache and units, so marginal throughput declines. Measure to find the knee before setting the concurrency cap.
map.首 token 延迟和吞吐冲突吗？: Do first-token latency and throughput conflict?
map.常冲突。大模型首 token 受预填充耗时影响，吞吐受解码并行影响；优化方向相反: Often yes. First-token latency is driven by prefill cost, while throughput is driven by decode parallelism; when the optimization directions oppose, choose by business (low latency for chat, high throughput for batch).
map.人均吞吐与判读（本页代码口径，与上方总吞吐互补）：人均吞吐=生成 tokens÷: Per-user throughput and interpretation (this page's code, complementary to total throughput above): per-user throughput=generated tokens÷(seconds×concurrent batch) (tokens/s, i.e. total throughput÷concurrency). Validation: shares the same inputs as total throughput; a duration or concurrency of 0 makes this item undefined and triggers the same warning. Grading: no fixed tiers; the larger the concurrent batch the lower the per-user throughput — batching trades longer single-request latency for total throughput, so online services must balance both against their SLO.
map.推理总吞吐（本页代码口径）：单请求时延=TTFT+（生成 tokens−1）×T: Total throughput (this page): request latency = TTFT + (generated tokens - 1) x TPOT; aggregate throughput = tokens x batch / request latency (tokens/s); per-request throughput = tokens / request latency. Validation: empty values fall back to 0; TTFT may be 0; a zero TPOT or batch makes results non-finite and adds the warning "some results undefined". Criteria: no fixed tiers; aggregate throughput measures fleet utilisation; results keep one decimal and show a dash when non-finite.
map.推理服务的核心指标：总吞吐衡量集群利用率，单请求吞吐才是用户感知的快慢。本页把端: A core metric for inference serving: aggregate throughput measures fleet utilisation, while per-request throughput is what users feel. This page splits end-to-end latency into first-token latency (TTFT) and per-token latency (TPOT): TTFT covers prefill and queuing, TPOT covers decode speed; total latency = TTFT + (tokens - 1) x TPOT. Real batching stretches both and hits bandwidth limits, so verify with measured TTFT/TPOT and choose against your SLO.
map.单请求吞吐与时延（本页代码口径，与上方总吞吐互补）：单请求时延=TTFT+（生成: Per-request throughput and latency (complements the total above): request latency = TTFT + (tokens - 1) x TPOT; per-request throughput = tokens / latency (tokens/s); average ms per token = latency x 1000 / tokens; pure decode speed ~ 1000 / TPOT (ms/token). Validation: shares the same inputs as total throughput; a zero TPOT or batch makes these terms undefined with the same warning. Criteria: this page does not model batching stretching TTFT/TPOT; capacity planning must use measured TTFT, TPOT and the bandwidth knee.
map.生成 200 token：TTFT 0.5s、TPOT 20ms ⇒ 单请求时延: 200 generated tokens with TTFT 0.5 s and TPOT 20 ms: request latency = 0.5 + 199 x 0.02 = 4.48 s, throughput = 200 / 4.48 ~ 44.6 tokens/s. With 4 concurrent requests on one GPU at ~44.6 tokens/s each, ideal aggregate throughput is ~178 tokens/s; shared KV cache and bandwidth keep the real gain below linear.
map.生成 200 token 耗时 4s → 吞吐=50 tokens/s。若单卡支: Generating 200 tokens in 4 s → throughput = 50 tokens/s. If one GPU supports 4 concurrent requests at 50 tokens/s each, total throughput ≈200 tokens/s; but shared KV cache and bandwidth make the concurrency gain sublinear.
